description: Your posting profiles, each with its connected social accounts: id, network, username, status and postable. Post only to accounts with postable: true; not_postable_reason says why not (reconnect needed, or X: coming soon). A postable TikTok account also has tiktok.privacy_level_options: the audiences it allows (e.g. PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, SELF_ONLY); ask the user which one before posting there.
name: list_profiles
title: List profiles and accounts
